With currentPath already /opt/nothingness/media and track 47 playing but scrolled off-screen (list showed 50-54), the new 'bring now-playing track into view' action (key void-crumb-bring-now-playing-into-view) was present; tapping it left currentPath unchanged and scrolled the list to reveal row 47 (pre: verification-d5404a88).

Playing track 47 while its row was fully visible (rows 44-51, 47 unclipped, isPlaying=true, songInfo=47 in same bundle): neither jump action appears in the tree or semantics, so the action is genuinely visibility-conditional.

getSemantics answers on this build; the action node carries a distinguishing Semantics label 'bring now-playing track into view' (and the cross-folder action carries 'jump to now-playing folder'), not a bare glyph.
